title: The bandit at Coyote Holes
text: On February 25, 1874, the outlaw Tiburcio Vásquez and his band robbed several freight wagon crews at Freeman Raymond's station, which was then called Coyote Holes. Vásquez preyed on stages and freighters traveling between the Kern River mines and Los Angeles.
